description: Serial checks against the FY69 UH-1H block 69-15000 to 69-15959; UH-1V medevac conversion; carries MARINES titles which are cosmetic - this is a US Army airframe; present in the current 2026 OpenStreetMap extract as node 13703867772 at 43.09597 -77.42308 on Freedom Hill which is a metre-level match to the Aerial Visuals fix; sources disagree whether the sponsor is American Legion Post 8495 or VFW Post 8495 - Perinton Memorial Post 8495 is a VFW post; also recorded as Perinton Memorial Post 8495
